description: This Java class 'ImportProductServices' provides a service method to import product and inventory data from spreadsheet files (XLS format) into the OFBiz system. It reads Excel files from a specified directory, processes each row to extract product information, checks for existing products, and creates new product and inventory item entities in the database.

classes.name: ImportProductServices
classes.description: A service class responsible for importing product data from spreadsheets into the OFBiz database, utilizing Apache POI for Excel file processing.

methods.name: productImportFromSpreadsheet
methods.description: Main service method that reads XLS files from a designated directory, processes each file to extract product and inventory data, and inserts new records into the database.
